_comment: Real published 2026 UPS/FedEx list rates (effective dates per carrier: UPS Dec 21 2025 daily rates sheet; FedEx Jan 5 2026 standard list rates sheet), sourced from the carriers' own published rate sheets. rates[w-1] gives [zone2..zone8] price for weight w (1-150 lb, whole-pound billing). These are PUBLISHED LIST/RETAIL rates, not any specific shipper's negotiated account rate, which is always lower and confidential to that account.

fuelSurchargePct._note: Estimated representative snapshot, not sourced from an official document. Real fuel surcharge percentages float weekly with the national on-highway diesel/jet fuel index and are typically higher for ground than air-expedited services.

ups_ground.label: UPS Ground
ups_ground._ratesNote: rates[i] = [zone2,zone3,zone4,zone5,zone6,zone7,zone8] price for weight (i+1) lb, i.e. rates[0] is 1 lb, rates[149] is 150 lb.
